summary: Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society (Jeevika) is recruiting 66 Young Professionals for its development program. This competitive program targets motivated young professionals under 30 years of age committed to rural development in Bihar. Selected candidates will undergo a structured 3-year Young Professional program.
eligibility_bullets: Maximum 3 years of post-qualification relevant work experience.
Not more than 30 years of age as on 2026-11-01.
Must have passed out from empaneled institutes before 2026-11-01.

Relevant work experience includes development agencies, government agencies, consulting firms, academic institutions engaged in rural or social development. Fellowship and teaching experience are not considered relevant.

vacancy_breakdown.notes: 35% horizontal reservation for Women in respective category, 2 seats for Grandson/granddaughter of freedom fighter & 3 seats for Person with benchmark disability

how_to_apply_steps: Candidates should apply online through the link: http://mis.brlps.in/YP_Recruitment_2026.
Visit www.brlps.in for more details about the organization and regular updates on YP recruitment in the career section.
Candidates are requested to frequently visit the website for announcements regarding shortlisted applications, dates, and venue of GD & PI.
